name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Direct financial support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of land-holding farmer families across India.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per annum paid in 3 instalments of ₹2,000 each
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) straight into linked Aadhaar bank account
Assists in procuring agricultural inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and equipment
applicationSteps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in).
Click on 'Farmers Corner' and select 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter your Aadhaar number, mobile number, and select your state.
Fill in land ownership details and upload property documents.
Submit the form and verify via OTP received on mobile.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest government-funded healthcare scheme providing health insurance cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
benefits: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers pre and post-hospitalization expenses, diagnostics, and surgeries
Empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide with no restriction on family size or age
applicationSteps: Visit pmjay.gov.in or nearest Ayushman Mitra kiosk / CSC center.
Click 'Am I Eligible' and enter your mobile number and state.
Verify eligibility via SECC 2011 data or Ration Card number.
Visit an empanelled hospital with Aadhaar to get your Golden Ayushman Card generated.
Use Ayushman Card for cashless treatment at empanelled facilities.

name: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India providing merit-cum-means financial scholarships to OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Class 9 to 12.
benefits: Scholarship of ₹75,000 per annum for Class 9 and 10 students
Scholarship of ₹1,25,000 per annum for Class 11 and 12 students
Covers school tuition fees, hostel fees, and educational materials
applicationSteps: Register on the NTA YASASVI portal (yet.nta.ac.in).
Fill in personal and academic details in the online portal.
Upload scanned copies of category certificate, income proof, and marksheets.
Appear for the YASASVI Entrance Test (if applicable for top school selection).
Track scholarship disbursement on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-Urban / Gramin)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Housing scheme providing financial subsidy and interest subvention for constructing or purchasing a pucca house for low-income and middle-income homeless families.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹2.67 Lakh as Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS)
Direct financial grant of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh for rural house construction
Subsidized interest rates on home loans for up to 20 years
documents: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house anywhere in India
applicationSteps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in or approach nearest Common Service Center (CSC).
Under 'Citizen Assessment', select 'Benefit under 3 components' or 'For Slum Dwellers'.
Enter Aadhaar details for authentication.
Fill out personal, income, and property details.
Track application status using Application Reference ID.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers providing fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after attaining 60 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension options: ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month
Same pension payable to spouse upon subscriber's death
Return of full accumulated pension wealth to nominee upon demise of both subscriber and spouse
applicationSteps: Visit your local bank branch or access net-banking portal.
Fill up APY registration form with Aadhaar and bank details.
Select monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and contribution frequency.
Enable auto-debit facility from your bank account.
Receive PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card confirmation.

name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors with capital subsidy up to 35% of project cost.
benefits: Subsidy up to 35% of project cost for rural areas and 25% for urban areas
Maximum project cost admissible: ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing & ₹20 Lakh for service sector
Generates self-employment opportunities for rural and urban youth
applicationSteps: Visit kviconline.gov.in/pmegp and click 'Application for New Unit'.
Fill online applicant details, select agency (KVIC/KVIB/DIC).
Upload detailed project report, Aadhaar, educational certificates.
Application is reviewed by District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC).
Sanctioned loan with margin money subsidy is released by bank.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Small savings scheme targeting girl children to secure their higher education and marriage expenses with attractive interest rates and tax exemptions under Section 80C.
benefits: High compounding interest rate (currently ~8.2% per annum)
Tax exemption under 80C up to ₹1.5 Lakh per annum with tax-free maturity returns
Partial withdrawal allowed after age 18 for higher education
documents: Aadhaar Card / ID Proof of Parent / Guardian
Passport Size Photograph of Child and Parent
applicationSteps: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Obtain and fill the SSY Account Opening Form.
Submit girl child's birth certificate along with guardian's Aadhaar and address proof.
Deposit initial minimum account opening amount (minimum ₹250).
Receive passbook for tracking yearly deposits.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit programme providing direct cash incentive of ₹5,000 for pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child to compensate for wage loss and nutritional support.
benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹5,000 paid in instalments into bank account
Additional benefit of ₹6,000 for second child if it is a girl child
Nutritional support and health checkup compensation
applicationSteps: Register at the local Anganwadi Center (AWC) or Healthcare Center.
Fill online application on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
Provide MCP card details, ANC checkup proof, and Aadhaar card.
Instalments are directly credited to mother's bank account upon milestone completion.

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Flagship skill certification scheme providing free industry-relevant skill training, certification, and job placement assistance to Indian youth.
benefits: Free short-term skill training in high-demand industrial sectors
Government-recognized Skill Certificate upon assessment
Financial assistance for travel, lodging, and placement stipend
applicationSteps: Visit pmkvyofficial.org and click 'Find Training Centre'.
Select desired skill sector (IT, Solar, Healthcare, Automotive, etc.).
Register with Aadhaar number and contact details.
Attend free training at nearest Skill Development Center.
Clear final assessment to receive NSDC Skill Certificate and placement assistance.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit scheme providing collateral-free working capital loans of up to ₹50,000 to street vendors affected by urban economic disruptions.
benefits: 1st tranche collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, 2nd tranche ₹20,000, and 3rd tranche ₹50,000
Interest subsidy of 7% per annum on timely repayment
Cashback incentives up to ₹1,200 per year on digital transactions
documents: Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
applicationSteps: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or approach nearest Common Service Center (CSC).
Click 'Apply for Loan' and enter mobile number linked with Aadhaar.
Select your Urban Local Body (ULB) / Municipal Corporation.
Fill loan request details and submit digital application.
Bank verifies credentials and disburses collateral-free loan.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Financial scheme providing collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 Lakh in Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun categories to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
benefits: Shishu Loan: up to ₹50,000 for starting new micro business
Kishor Loan: ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh for expanding business
Tarun Loan: ₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh for established small enterprises
No collateral required; Mudra Card issued for easy credit access
applicationSteps: Visit udyamimitra.in or approach any commercial bank branch.
Choose loan category (Shishu, Kishor, or Tarun).
Fill out Mudra Loan Application Form with business plan details.
Submit required identity, address, and quotation documents.
Sanctioned loan is disbursed along with Mudra Debit Card.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
hindiName: राष्ट्रीय साधन सह योग्यता छात्रवृत्ति योजना
ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Scholarship awarded to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts at Class 8 and encourage education up to Class 12.
benefits: Scholarship amount of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month)
Disbursed directly into student's bank account via Public Financial Management System (PFMS)
Covers Class 9, 10, 11, and 12 education expenses
applicationSteps: Apply on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Register under National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship scheme.
Appear for State-level NMMS Selection Examination conducted in Class 8.
Qualifying students upload marksheet and bank account details for annual renewal.

name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Concessional credit scheme for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) to start income-generating micro-enterprises, skill development, or pursue higher education.
benefits: Concessional loan up to ₹50 Lakh with low interest rate (5% to 9% per annum)
Interest rebate of 1% for female beneficiaries with disability
Supports purchase of assistive vehicles, commercial machinery, and business setups
applicationSteps: Visit National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation portal (nhfdc.nic.in).
Submit application through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) or RRBs.
Attach UDID Card copy and project proposal.
Upon verification, loan is disbursed directly with subsidized interest rates.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial coverage against crop failure, natural disasters, pests, and unseasonal rainfall for all food, oilseed, and annual commercial crops.
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance with low premium rates (1.5% for Rabi, 2.0% for Kharif crops)
Full insured sum claim payout directly transferred to bank account for crop loss
Coverage for localized calamities and post-harvest losses
documents: Sowing Certificate issued by Gram Panchayat / Revenue Department
applicationSteps: Visit pmfby.gov.in or contact nearest bank / CSC portal.
Fill online farmer registration form and select crop season.
Provide land survey number and crop sowing details.
Pay nominal farmer premium amount online.
In case of crop damage, intimate within 72 hours via PMFBY Crop Insurance App.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
hindiName: इंद्रा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Social security pension scheme providing monthly financial assistance to senior citizens belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per month (combined central and state contribution)
Higher pension rate for senior citizens aged 80 years and above
Direct Bank Transfer every month without friction
documents: Age Proof (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / Passport)
applicationSteps: Visit Block Development Office (BDO) or Gram Panchayat office.
Obtain National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) application form.
Attach BPL ration card copy and age proof.
Verification conducted by District Social Welfare Officer.
Monthly pension credited to savings bank account.

name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Empowerment initiative enabling women in rural Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to start sustainable micro-enterprises and earn an annual income of at least ₹1 Lakh.
benefits: Interest-free loans up to ₹5 Lakh for micro-enterprises
Skill training in entrepreneurship, tailoring, drone piloting, LED bulb making, and agriculture
Direct market linkage and digital branding support
documents: Self Help Group (SHG) Membership Card / Certificate
applicationSteps: Join or approach local Women Self Help Group (SHG) under DAY-NRLM.
Express interest in micro-enterprise training and enterprise loan.
Participate in skill development workshop conducted by NRLM.
Submit micro-business plan to Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU).
Receive revolving seed fund and enterprise loan.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Food security welfare scheme delivering 5 kg of free foodgrains per person per month to over 80 crore vulnerable and low-income beneficiaries across India.
benefits: 5 kg of free wheat or rice per beneficiary per month
Distributed free of cost over and above regular subsidized quota under NFSA
Portability across India under 'One Nation One Ration Card' system
documents: National Food Security Act (NFSA) Ration Card / Antyodaya Anna Yojana Card
applicationSteps: Ensure Aadhaar is linked to your Ration Card.
Visit any Fair Price Shop (FPS) ration dealer in your locality.
Perform biometric authentication on ePOS machine.
Receive 5 kg free foodgrain entitlement.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
hindiName: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के लिए उत्तर-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing complete tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance to SC/ST students pursuing post-secondary studies.
benefits: 100% tuition fee reimbursement for government and private colleges
Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200 for hostellers and ₹550 for day scholars
Additional allowances for study tours and thesis writing
documents: Caste Certificate (SC/ST issued by competent authority)
applicationSteps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students'.
Upload caste certificate, income proof, college fee receipt.
Institute verifies application online.
Funds disbursed directly into student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
hindiName: इंद्रा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Financial protection scheme providing monthly pension support to widows living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension allowance of ₹300 to ₹1,000 per month
Direct credit to beneficiary savings account
Social security and dignity for vulnerable women
applicationSteps: Obtain NSAP application form from local Taluk / Panchayat office.
Attach husband's death certificate and BPL ration card.
Submit to Social Welfare Officer for verification.
Monthly pension is remitted directly into beneficiary's bank account.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Timely credit support to farmers at highly subsidized interest rates to meet agricultural, harvesting, and post-crop financial requirements.
benefits: Revolving credit facility with low interest rate of 4% per annum (after 3% prompt repayment subvention)
No collateral required for loans up to ₹1.60 Lakh
Includes personal accident insurance coverage up to ₹50,000
documents: No-Dues Certificate from neighboring bank branches
applicationSteps: Visit any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or PM-KISAN portal.
Fill out KCC application form with crop cultivated details.
Submit land land registry documents and identity proof.
Bank inspects land records and issues KCC Smart Card with credit limit.

name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Provides free hemodialysis services to Below Poverty Line (BPL) renal failure patients in District Hospitals across all states and Union Territories.
benefits: 100% free hemodialysis procedures for BPL patients
Subsidized low-cost treatment for non-BPL patients at public health facilities
Reduces catastrophic out-of-pocket medical expenditure
documents: Medical Certificate / Nephrologist Prescription for Dialysis
applicationSteps: Visit District Hospital or Empanelled Dialysis Center under National Health Mission.
Produce Nephrologist referral and BPL certificate.
Register at the PMNDP counter to schedule free dialysis sessions.
